pull_requests.title: Manifest schema v0: capability allow-list
pull_requests.author: naomi
pull_requests.head: schema/manifest-v0
pull_requests.body: Capabilities are an allow-list (`fs.read`, `net.egress`, `tk.reference`). Anything not listed is denied. I'd rather over-restrict now and loosen later.

reviews.body: Exactly right. The deny-by-default posture is what makes review tractable.

comments.body: Can we drop `net.egress` entirely pending the arch review? I'm going to argue against self-declared egress.
Good call — I'll gate it behind the arch decision. Left it in but marked experimental.
(added 2026-05-04) This is the change that disabled the capability check and broke the smoke test. Flagging for the incident retro — not to pile on Ben, who surfaced it himself.

pull_requests.title: Provenance field on skill artifacts
pull_requests.author: marcus
pull_requests.head: schema/provenance
pull_requests.body: Adds `provenance` to the artifact schema: author, source_community, tk_references[]. Co-developed with @lily after we realized platform and governance were building the same field twice. One schema, owned jointly.

reviews.body: This replaces the parallel field I was building on the governance side. Glad we caught it before both shipped.
tk_references[] should reference the Local Contexts label id, not free text, once the ADR lands.
Good catch Naomi — changed my mind on the free-text approach, now it's a typed label reference. Updated.

pull_requests.title: Reviewer console: enforce capability consent at install
pull_requests.author: priya
pull_requests.head: ui/consent-enforce
pull_requests.body: Consent screen now reflects the enforced allow-list. Denied capabilities can't run — the screen is no longer cosmetic.

reviews.body: Added a regression test that fails loudly if the capability check is ever disabled again. Never getting a repeat of #41.
